status: accepted within documented static catalog scope
reviewedBehavior: All 150 descriptor addresses, handler RVAs and flag words independently match original PE bytes. Eleven recorded bank identities/states agree with the original slots and verified registration paths.

Bank and index rejection enforces only the 10-bit and 16-bit opcode representations. Unrecorded banks and descriptors remain unknown, with absent handler/arity/return/flag metadata rather than invented zero values or claimed native bounds.

The five interior NULL-handler records in bank 0 remain explicit holes; later descriptors are retained. Bank 3 and bank 9 distinguish context-installed tables from original NULL registry slots and do not promise live availability.
Metadata is held in private frozen dictionaries with immutable scalar/string records and tuple keys. A caller-created record copy does not mutate subsequent lookups.

The actual compiled Core assembly successfully deserializes its exact embedded System.Text.Json resource. Schema, executable identity, representable metadata keys and descriptor arithmetic are checked; duplicate keys fail construction.

Annotation 1:6 correctly preserves declared arity 12 while documenting handler reads of scratch slots 12 through 15. Complete original-byte-verified handler 42E220 and callee 3CA0E0 show that the callee consumes slots 12 through 14; slot 15 is copied by the wrapper. The VM scratch array is not initially cleared, so the corrected wording allows uninitialized contents as well as values from earlier calls.

data.scope: All numeric descriptors/bank snapshot states checked against original bytes. Selected1:6 native bodies rechecked. This does not independently re-prove every descriptive annotation.

resolvedReviewNote.resolution: Parent corrected generated text to uninitialized scratch contents or values left by an earlier native call before the final data and compiled API runs.

limits: This review independently proves all numeric catalog rows and registry-state semantics, not all 44 descriptive annotations. The selected 1:6 native discrepancy was rederived; the separate 0:84 NaN correction was supplied by another reviewer and is included in the reviewed JSON hash.
The resource is build-owned data with no public external-JSON loading API. Malformed-resource fuzzing, trim/AOT publication and every future schema change are outside this review.

The runtime probe covers all 65536 indices in thirteen banks, samples all 1024 representable banks, and exercises representation rejection and copy isolation. It does not execute game/native handlers or prove that a catalogued native call is safe.
The parent test source was read and hashed, but this receipt attributes the reported 2559890 checks only to the independent probe, not to a rerun of the parent full test suite.
